# HyperTune Garage — Performance • Protection • Perfection

> HyperTune Garage is an independent automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics center, Paint Protection Film (PPF) studio, detailing bay, and multi-brand mechanical repair facility located in Islamabad and serving Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Official website: https://hypertunegarage.pk/

## Business Identity & Workshop Overview

- **Business Name:** HyperTune Garage (Independent Automotive Workshop)
- **Official Website:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/
- **Official Slogan:** Performance • Protection • Perfection
- **Service Coverage:** Islamabad and Rawalpindi (in-workshop service at Islamabad Flagship Hub and insured valet pickup across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, including DHA and Bahria Town)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +92 333 0177717
- **Email:** info@hypertunegarage.pk
- **Operating Hours:** Saturday – Thursday, 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Friday Closed)
- **Google Rating:** 4.8 / 5.0 Stars

## Workshop Locations

- **[Islamabad Flagship Hub](https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/islamabad-workshop/):** Open & Operating — Shop 1-G, Ground Floor, Central Ave, O-9 Block E Police Foundation, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan. Features 8 hydraulic lifts, Italian 3D laser wheel alignment, dust-free PPF & 9H ceramic coating studio, computerized CAD plotter, and electronics diagnostics lab.
- **[Rawalpindi Coverage Hub](https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/rawalpindi-workshop/):** Coming Soon — Currently serving Rawalpindi customers through the Islamabad Flagship Hub with insured valet vehicle pickup.

## Core Automotive Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf/): CAD plotter pre-cut self-healing TPU PPF in dust-free bays with up to 10-year manufacturer warranty.
- [Car Detailing](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-detailing/): Multi-stage dual-action paint correction, 9H nano-ceramic coating, interior steam extraction, and leather care.
- [Engine Services & Overhaul](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services/): Complete petrol, turbo, hybrid, and diesel diagnostics, cylinder head repair, timing kits, and master rebuilds.
- [Inspection & Diagnostics](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/inspection-diagnostics/): Brand-level computerized fault scanning, 200-point pre-purchase inspections, odometer cross-checks, and paint-depth micron audits.
- [Maintenance & Servicing](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/maintenance-servicing/): Scheduled full-synthetic oil changes, genuine OEM filters, fluid checks, and 50-point health reports.
- [Brake, Suspension & Steering](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brake-suspension-steering/): Brake pad/rotor servicing, air and coil suspension rebuilds, steering rack repairs, and 3D laser wheel alignment.
- [Transmission & Drivetrain](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-drivetrain/): Automatic, CVT, DSG/DCT/PDK gearbox diagnostics, mechatronic repairs, fluid flushes, and 4x4 drivetrain service.
- [Vehicle Wrap](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/vehicle-wrap/): Cast vinyl color-change wraps in gloss, satin, matte, metallic, and carbon finishes with tucked edges.
- [Body Repair & Paint](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-repair-paint/): Paintless Dent Repair (PDR), frame alignment, spectrophotometer color matching, and downdraft heated paint booth refinishing.
- [Body Modification](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-modification/): Custom body kits, wide-body fitment, splitters, diffusers, spoilers, and carbon fiber styling parts.
- [AC Repair & Electrical Specialist](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-ac-repair/): Automated R134a/R1234yf AC service, compressor and cooling coil repair, parasitic drain tracing, and auto-electrical diagnostics.
- [Cooling System, Fuel Injection & Exhaust](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/cooling-fuel-exhaust/): Closed-loop radiator flushing, OAT coolant service, ultrasonic injector cleaning, water pumps, and catalytic converter care.

## Vehicle Brands and Specialist Services

HyperTune Garage operates as an independent specialist workshop supporting 28 automotive brands across Islamabad and Rawalpindi:

- **[BMW](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/bmw-repair-islamabad/):** Independent BMW repair and diagnostics using ISTA-D, ISTA-P, and ICOM Next for 3, 5, 7, X, and M Series—covering B48/B58/N20/N55 engines, VANOS, Valvetronic, ZF 8HP transmissions, oil leak repairs, and PPF.
- **[Mercedes-Benz](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mercedes-service-islamabad/):** Independent Mercedes-Benz and AMG servicing using Xentry Diagnosis and Star Diagnosis C4/C6 DoIP for C, E, S, G63 AMG, and SUVs—covering Airmatic air suspension, 7G/9G-Tronic gearboxes, M274/M264 timing, and EQ hybrids.
- **[Audi](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/audi-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Audi and VAG servicing using ODIS, VAS 6154 DoIP, and VCDS for A3–A8, Q2–Q8, and RS models—covering S-Tronic/DSG mechatronics, EA888 TFSI oil consumption and carbon walnut blasting, and Quattro maintenance.
- **[Porsche](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/porsche-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Porsche engineering care using PIWIS Tester III for 911, 718, Cayenne, Panamera, Macan, and Taycan—covering PDK dual-clutch servicing, PASM air suspension, coolant pipe upgrades, PCCB/Brembo brakes, and PPF.
- **[Toyota](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/toyota-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Toyota maintenance using Techstream and hybrid load benches for Corolla, Yaris, Fortuner, Hilux Revo, Prado, Land Cruiser LC200/LC300, Prius, and Aqua—covering P0A80 hybrid batteries, 1VD/1GD diesel injectors, KDSS, and CVT-FE fluid service.
- **[Honda](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/honda-service-islamabad/):** Independent Honda servicing using HDS and i-HDS for Civic (including 1.5L Turbo), Vezel Hybrid, City, HR-V, BR-V, Accord, CR-V, and Fit/Grace—covering i-DCD dual-clutch actuator repairs, intake walnut blasting, HCF-2 CVTs, and EPS steering racks.
- **[Suzuki](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/suzuki-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Suzuki servicing using SDT-II for Alto, Cultus, Swift, Wagon R, Jimny, Every, and JDM Kei hybrids—covering AGS actuator calibration, K-Series engine overhauls, EPS column rattles, AC cooling, and suspension rebuilds.
- **[Hyundai](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/hyundai-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Hyundai servicing using GDS-Mobile and VCI-II for Tucson, Elantra, Sonata, Santa Fe Hybrid, Staria, Ioniq, and H-100—covering DCT and 6/8-speed transmissions, Smartstream/Nu engines, EPB calibration, and AWD couplings.
- **[Kia](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/kia-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Kia maintenance using KDS and VCI-II for Sportage, Sorento, Grand Carnival, Stonic, Picanto, Stinger, and EV6—covering Sportage AWD couplings, MDPS steering couplers, V6/CRDi engines, and panoramic sunroof servicing.
- **[Changan](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/changan-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Changan servicing using OEM CAN diagnostic rigs for Oshan X7, Alsvin, Karvaan, Deepal S07/L07, and UNI models—covering 5-speed and 7-speed wet DCT transmissions, Blue Core 1.5T engines, ADAS calibration, and EV checks.
- **[Haval](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/haval-service-islamabad/):** Independent Haval and GWM servicing using GWM factory-grade diagnostic rigs for H6, H6 HEV, Jolion, Tank 500, and Ora 03—covering Dedicated Hybrid Transmission (DHT) diagnostics, 7-speed wet DCTs, AWD systems, and ADAS calibration.
- **[MG](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mg-repair-islamabad/):** Independent MG maintenance using MG VDS diagnostics for MG HS (1.5T, Trophy AWD, PHEV), MG ZS, MG ZS EV, MG 4/5 EV, and MG GT—covering 7-speed DCT calibration, turbo diagnostics, cooling bleeding, and EV battery health checks.
- **[BYD](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/byd-ev-service-islamabad/):** Independent BYD electric and hybrid servicing using BYD VDS3.0 and insulation testers for Atto 3, Seal, Sealion 6, Song Plus DM-i, Dolphin, Han, and Tang—covering Blade Battery SOH analysis, DM-i powertrains, and DiPilot ADAS calibration.
- **[Chery](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/chery-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Chery and Omoda servicing using ACTECO diagnostic rigs for Tiggo 8 Pro, Tiggo 8 Pro e+ PHEV, Tiggo 4 Pro, Omoda 5, and Arrizo—covering TGDI intake de-coking, 7-speed wet DCTs, CVTs, and climate control repairs.
- **[Isuzu](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/isuzu-dmax-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Isuzu 4x4 and diesel servicing using G-IDSS and Tech 2 for D-Max V-Cross, Hi-Lander, MU-X, and N-Series trucks—covering 4JJ1/4JJ3/RZ4E common-rail diesels, VGT turbos, DPF cleaning, and leaf spring suspensions.
- **[FAW](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/faw-repair-islamabad/):** Independent FAW passenger and light commercial servicing using FAW OBD-II scanners for V2, X-PV, Carrier, Sirius S80, and J5P/J6—covering 1.3L VCT-i engine rebuilds, manual gearboxes, radiator cooling upgrades, and fleet maintenance.
- **[Daihatsu](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/daihatsu-service-islamabad/):** Independent Daihatsu JDM Kei and classic servicing using DS-II and DST-i for Mira, Move, Cast, Tanto, Hijet, Coure, Terios, and Rocky—covering Eco-Idle battery calibration, Amix CVT service, KF-VE/KF-DET engines, and Smart Assist alignment.
- **[Nissan](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/nissan-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Nissan servicing using Consult-III Plus for Note e-Power, X-Trail, Dayz, Juke, Sunny, Navara, Patrol Y62 V8, and GT-R—covering Xtronic CVT repairs with NS-3 fluid, e-Power inverter cooling, and HBMC suspension.
- **[Mitsubishi](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mitsubishi-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Mitsubishi 4x4 and JDM servicing using MUT-III SE for Pajero, Outlander PHEV, Lancer/Evo, Ek Wagon, Mirage, and L200—covering Super Select 4WD-II actuators, 4M41 diesel injection, PHEV high-voltage care, and INVECS-III CVTs.
- **[Mazda](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mazda-service-islamabad/):** Independent Mazda SkyActiv servicing using IDS and M-MDS for Mazda 3, Mazda 6, CX-3, CX-5, CX-9, Demio, and MX-5—covering SkyActiv-G walnut intake cleaning, SkyActiv-Drive ATF-FZ transmission service, i-ELOOP, and i-ActivSense calibration.
- **[Subaru](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/subaru-boxer-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Subaru Boxer and AWD care using SSM4 for Forester, Outback, Legacy, XV/Crosstrek, Impreza, WRX/STI, and BRZ—covering Boxer head gaskets, Lineartronic CVTs, Symmetrical AWD transfer clutches, and EyeSight camera calibration.
- **[Lexus](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/lexus-hybrid-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Lexus luxury and hybrid care using Lexus Techstream for LX570, LX600, RX, NX, ES, GX, and LS—covering P0A80 hybrid battery balancing, AHC hydraulic suspension bleeding, V8/Twin-Turbo V6 engines, and Mark Levinson audio repair.
- **[Land Rover](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/land-rover-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Land Rover servicing using JLR Pathfinder DoIP and SDD for Defender (L663 and Classic), Discovery 3/4/5, and Freelander—covering air suspension rebuilds, Ingenium timing chains, Terrain Response 4x4, and ZF 8HP gearboxes.
- **[Range Rover](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/range-rover-service-islamabad/):** Independent Range Rover luxury SUV care using JLR Pathfinder DoIP and SDD for Vogue, Sport, Velar, Evoque, and PHEVs—covering Dynamic Air Suspension, ARC hydraulics, 5.0L Supercharged V8 cooling upgrades, and deployable side steps.
- **[Jeep](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/jeep-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Jeep 4x4 servicing using Chrysler/Stellantis wiTECH 2.0 and MicroPod II for Wrangler, Grand Cherokee, Gladiator, Cherokee, and Compass—covering death wobble fixes, Pentastar V6 oil coolers, Quadra-Lift suspension, and Dana axles.
- **[Ford](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/ford-service-islamabad/):** Independent Ford servicing using FDRS, IDS, and VCM-3 for F-150/Raptor, Ranger/Raptor, Everest, Mustang, and Explorer—covering EcoBoost carbon cleaning, 10R80 10-speed Mercon ULV servicing, wet timing belts, and Fox Live Valve suspension.
- **[Chevrolet](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/chevrolet-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Chevrolet and GM servicing using GDS2, MDI-2, and Tech2 for Tahoe, Suburban, Silverado, Corvette C7/C8, Camaro, Captiva, Cruze, and Joy—covering V8 AFM/DFM lifter repairs, 8L90/10L80 transmissions, and MagneRide dampers.
- **[Volvo](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/volvo-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Volvo servicing using VIDA and DiCE/VOE DoIP for XC90, XC60, XC40 Recharge, S90, S60, V90, and C40—covering T8 Twin-Engine PHEV and ERAD servicing, Drive-E twin-charged engines, Four-C air suspension, and IntelliSafe calibration.
